decision_log: Steam trailer 'Zid Journey (2026 trailer)' 43 s: server shot picker gave 5 clean stretches (text, frozen and smear stretches rejected); split template with date and platform strip; trailer sound; Shade of the Marionette tried first: only its Steam teaser exists as a file (the gameplay trailer is YouTube only) and every stretch carries a work-in-progress overlay, so no clean shot; v1 render stopped on a blocky-smear flag at 10.07 to 10.97 s (the 1.9 s hand-drawn scene at source 11.93 s), so that shot was dropped and not waived; v2 flagged again (8.53 to 9.43 s) though the source stretches and the whole 43 s file read clean in decodecheck.smear_times, so the flag comes from the crossfade over hand-drawn line art: hard cuts (cut true) for v3; v3 flagged at 9.43 to 10.53 s, the cut into the last shot, same cause; waived with block_ok after two rounds (source decode and smear read clean on the full file)
block_ok: flag at the cut into the last shot (source 31.68 s) of a hand-drawn line-art scene; decodecheck.smear_times over each source stretch and the whole 43 s Steam file reads clean, so it is the scene change, not decode damage
